name: Intercede
overview: Scripture reveals intercession as a solemn responsibility where believers stand as mediators before God on behalf of others. Abraham’s humble appeal to the Lord (Genesis 18:27) and Moses’ reverent worship (Exodus 34:8) exemplify the posture of one who intercedes. Ezekiel’s call to be a watchman who warns the people (Ezekiel 3:17, 3:20) and to stand in the gap to prevent judgment (Ezekiel 22:30) underscores the weight of intercession in spiritual accountability and mercy. Intercession involves both pleading for mercy and faithfully delivering God’s warnings, reflecting a Christ-centered ministry of reconciliation and justice.
